_about: What the bot may write on the things in Dennis's room (pipeline/room_writing.py). Edit freely: a line too long for its thing is shrunk to fit, and each video takes different ones from each list, so a list needs at least twice as many as one video uses (3 notes, 3 cards, 1 sign). With Gemma running, the notes and cards are written from that video's script instead and these are only the fallback. A new line on a card is a new line in the text.
